AllergenCode.description: **The fourteen declarable allergens, as one closed list.** Every allergen field in this contract uses it — the menu claim, the ticket line, a substitution's delta, a modifier option, the label on a bag — so a declared set and an actual set compare without anybody normalising case or synonyms. It was the `Allergen.contains` enum; the other fields were free text.

CoursingPolicy.description: How a ticket's courses are fired. `fireAndForget` sends every course at once, which is no coursing; `holdAndFire` waits for a server to call each course; `timed` fires on a clock; `phased` staggers by course. **One vocabulary for the ticket (`KitchenTicket.coursing`) and the outlet default (`CourseRules.defaultCoursing`)** — the default said `none` for `fireAndForget` and had no `delayed` until 26 September, so a default could not be copied onto the field it defaults.

FnbReservationPolicy.description: **How long a table is held, and what sits between one seating and the next.** The source of `TableReservation.durationMinutes`, which keeps its own value as the snapshot.

outletId.description: Null is the venue default; an outlet's own policy overrides it.

defaultTurnMinutes.description: The turn time when no party-size band matches.

turnTimeBands.description: **Turn time by party size** — a two-top and a table of eight do not turn at the same speed, and a single default is how a restaurant ends up double-booking its large tables. The first band whose range contains the party size wins.

seatingBufferMinutes.description: **The reset between seatings** — clearing, laying and a moment for the floor. Zero is a legitimate answer and a stated one.

maximumDurationMinutes.description: **The ceiling on a single booking.** A reservation extended by hand past this needs the manager, because the table after it is somebody else's booking.

FnbServiceChargePolicy.description:
**What the service charge on a bill is, and where it came from.** Every field here answers a question `fnb.sub_bill.service_charge` was being asked and could not answer.
**Tax and service charge recompute per bill on a split** (`F29`), so the policy is resolved per bill rather than apportioned from the visit — which only works if there is a policy to resolve.

basis.description: `none` is a real answer and the default. **A venue that does not levy one should say so**, rather than leaving a null that reads as unconfigured.

minimumPartySize.description: **The common case for an automatic charge** — parties of six and above. Null applies it to every cover.

serviceTypes.description: **A delivery order charged a dine-in service charge is a complaint.** Empty means every service type.

isTaxable.description: **Whether VAT applies to the charge itself.** It does in the UAE, and a bill that taxes the subtotal but not the charge is understated.

includedInDisplayPrice.description: **Menu-price inclusive or added at the bill.** The pair of this and `shownSeparately` is what a guest is entitled to see before ordering.

isDiscretionary.description: **Whether a guest may have it removed.** A charge that cannot be declined is a price; a charge that can is a request, and the bill has to say which.

distribution.description: **Not a tip.** `orders` separates `serviceCharge` from a gratuity because it is revenue in most jurisdictions and pooling the two is how a payroll dispute starts. This is the field that carries the distinction into payroll.

orderId.description: The F&B order the ticket was created from on acceptance (`FnbOrder.id`).

coursing.description:
BL-131. **Starters before mains is the entire job of a kitchen pass**, and the model fired everything at once.
`holdAndFire` waits for a server to call it; `timed` fires on a clock; `phased` staggers by course. **Without this a table gets its dessert while eating its starter.**

buzzerCode.description: BL-128. **The pager number handed to a guest at a counter.** Recorded against the order so a lost buzzer is a lookup rather than an argument.

priority.description: Higher fires sooner. Raised by Fast Pass or supervisor override.

refireOfLineId.description: **Set on a refire.** The line it remakes, which stays — food cost counts both, the bill counts one (`refireItem`).

isChargeable.description: A refire's `chargeable` flag. Null on a line that is not a refire.

KpiValue.description: BI board 10.3. **Value, target, variance, direction and freshness in one read.**

bucketStart.description: The start of the bucket this value covers, when `getKpiValues` was asked for an `interval`; null otherwise.

groupKey.description: The value of the `groupBy` dimension this row is for (a status, a category code, a tier); null when no `groupBy` was asked.

stale.description: **True when the pipeline behind it has not refreshed.** A number nobody flagged as stale is a number somebody will act on.

publishedVersion.description: The `MenuVersion.version` live now. Null for a menu never published.

MenuAvailability.description: When this menu is in force. Absent means always. Days, times and dates are all read in the Region's time zone, not UTC.

startTime.description: Wall-clock time, in the Region's time zone.

endTime.description: Wall-clock time, in the Region's time zone.

validFrom.description: Calendar day, in the Region's time zone, not UTC.

validTo.description: Calendar day, in the Region's time zone, not UTC.

items.description: The section's items, in sale-board order. An item's membership is `MenuItem.menuSectionId`.

MetricValue.description:
**A reading of a metric or KPI, or a threshold on one.** A `Money` where the metric is money-valued — `MetricSource` lists those in `x-ticvai-money-valued`, and a KPI is when its `unit` is `currency` — and a plain number otherwise. naming-and-style 5.1: money is never a float, at any layer.
Stored as `numeric(18,4)` either way: a money value stores its amount, and currency and scale resolve from the scope as they do for every `Money`.

OpeningHoursWindow.description: 26 September, pull audit R088. **One weekly window an outlet is open.** `Outlet.openingHours` was an array of untyped objects. The shape is the one `supportHours.windows` already uses — a day and a from/to — with the times as local `HH:MM` in the region's time zone. Several windows on one day are a split shift, such as lunch and dinner.

from.description: Local time, 24-hour `HH:MM`, when the outlet opens.

to.description: Local time, 24-hour `HH:MM`, when the outlet closes.

stockLocationId.description: Where this outlet draws stock from. A shop and its stockroom are one location; a bar drawing from a central cellar is not.

costCenterId.description: Revenue and cost attribution. Outlet is the natural grain for both.

openingHours.description: The weekly pattern, one entry per window. Several windows on a day are allowed.

OutletTemplate.description: **The configuration a new outlet is created from** (decided 29 September, readiness close-out; BO-730). New table. Copied into the outlet at creation and never linked after, so changing a template does not change existing outlets.

scopePath.description: The venue it belongs to; server-set.

serviceModel.description: The service modes the outlet offers, e.g. `[tableService, collection]`.

courseRules.description: The coursing default a new outlet starts with; the same shape `setCourseRules` stores per outlet.

kitchenSlaMinutes.description: The default ticket target, in minutes, before `setKitchenSla` sets per-mode targets.

OutletTemplateType.description: The F&B kinds of `tenancy.OutletKind`, repeated here because a satellite does not reference another contract's schema.

RefireReason.description: Why a line was made again (`refireItem`). The reasons are the data.

SectionLayout.description: An outlet's floor divided into sections, each with its server (`setSectionLayout`).

TableDefinition.description: A restaurant (dining) table, reserved with `createTableReservation`. Not a map-bookable `resources` table, which is a non-dining spot sold like a cabana (decided 29 September, rev 3 GAP-C2).

label.description: **The table code, unique per venue** (decided 28 September, audit R108). Two tables in one venue never share a label, across all its outlets, so *T12* names one table wherever it is read. `createTable` and `updateTable` refuse a duplicate with `409` `duplicate-code`.

isOutOfService.description: **Damaged, or its section closed.** `getTableMap` shows it as `outOfService` and a claim on it is refused with `tableOutOfService`.
